messages:
Alex (sales): Hey folks — Nimbus Health POC hitting intermittent 429s on /v1/embeddings during a bulk import. They started at ~10:30am PT, spikes every 2–3m. Customer is blocked for demo tomorrow.

Samir (SE): Thanks. Quick q: how many concurrent workers and avg tokens per request?

Alex (sales): 8 workers, ~1k tokens per request, using our JS streaming helper. Error payload shows rate_limit_exceeded and sometimes header X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0.

Jin (eng): Can you paste an example error+headers?

Alex (sales): Sure — copying one of the responses:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Type: application/json
X-RateLimit-Limit: 600000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1680000060
Retry-After: 12
\n{"error":{"type":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"per-route token budget exceeded"}}
```

Maria (sre): That looks like a per-route token budget window firing (not global token pool). For trial tenants we have a short burst window (60s) to prevent noisy imports.

Jin (eng): FYI we pushed R-TRIAL-60 policy last week which enforces per-route caps for trial tenants. There's also a known accounting mismatch when streaming + prefix KV cache are both charged per chunk — we saw a discrepancy in staging where streaming batches counted prefix tokens twice.

Samir (SE): Customer's import tool uses streaming and also does a quick prefix probe per item — that could double-count. Workarounds: 1) reduce concurrency to 2–3, 2) increase chunk size to 4–5k tokens, 3) client-side backoff + exponential retry on 429.

Alex (sales): Customer asked if we can just bump quotas for the POC for 24–48h so they can finish the import. Can SRE grant a soft bump while eng looks at the accounting?

Maria (sre): I can apply a temporary per-route softcap multiplier for tenant=nimbus-health for 36h (3x). I'll also enable extra logging on the quota ledger so we can correlate. Applying now.

ratebot: quota-manager: applied softcap multiplier=3 for tenant=nimbus-health until 1777680000.

Jin (eng): Thanks. I'll open a hotfix ticket to dedupe streaming vs prefix accounting — root cause is double-increment in token_ledger when streaming chunks trigger prefix cache checks. ETA for patch: 48h, deploy after CI.

Samir (SE): In the meantime, here's a small snippet to implement client-side backoff + chunking recommendation:

```
# pseudocode
for batch in chunks(items, size=4000):
  try:
    resp = client.embeddings.create(model="open-embed-2", input=batch)
  except RateLimitError as e:
    sleep(exp_backoff())
    retry()
```

Alex (sales): I told Nimbus to drop concurrency to 2 and use 4k chunks, and that we granted a temporary bump. They're rerunning import now and will report back in ~30m.

Maria (sre): I'll watch the quota ledger and post updates. If we see sustained high usage we can throttle the softcap down and call out.

Jin (eng): I'll instrument a small metric to count double-charged token events so we can quantify impact across trials.

Alex (sales): Update from Nimbus — after the change they got through ~60% of batch without 429s, then a handful of 429s but all retried and completed. They asked whether this will affect billing for the POC.

Maria (sre): Softcap bumps are for availability only — billing stays standard. If they want guaranteed higher throughput we should move them to a Dedicated evaluation (we can provide pricing).

Samir (SE): Noted. I'll follow up on migration docs and cost estimate.

Alex (sales): Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll close once Nimbus finishes import and confirms demo. If Jin needs logs or a tenant dump for repro, ping me and I'll share with eng infra. :+1:

Maria (sre): Logged monitoring alert rule 'nimbus-poc-ratewatch' and will keep channel posted.

Jin (eng): Thanks — adding task INF-842 to track the accounting fix.

Alex (sales): closing loop for now. Will reopen here if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
